title: Te Reo i Hono atu ki ngā Maunga
intro: I whakawhiwhia tētahi wairua tika ki ngā taonga whakamiharo mai i te rangi, ka noho hei rangatira, hei toa, ko tōna āhua tūturu te āhua nei e hono ana ki te hanganga tonu. Ka rarangahia tā rāua kōrero i roto i te poropititanga, te rangatiratanga, me te mahi toi, ka waiho he taonga tuku iho e rangona ana i roto i ngā whārangi o te whakakitenga atua.
clues: I whiriwhiria ahau hei pononga mā Allah, ā, i tukuna mai he kingitanga nui ki ahau i roto i tētahi iwi whiriwhiri.
Ka haruru tahi mai ngā maunga me ngā manu i ahau e whakakororia ana i te Runga Rawa.
I ngawari te rino pērā i te paru i roto i ōku ringa, nā te hiahia o Allah anake.
I hanga e au he pukupuku tiaki hei tiaki i ngā toa i te werawera o te pakanga.
I paahitia e au tētahi whakamātautau uaua i te wā i tomo ohorere mai ai ētahi tāngata tautohe tokorua ki roto i taku wāhi karakia.
Kua whakahuatia ahau i te taha o tētahi rangatira nāna i whakahau te hau me ngā jinn — nā te mea ko taua rangatira nōku ake uri.

trial.answer: Tokorua ngā tāngata tautohe i uru mai ki roto i taku wāhi karakia

location.answer: He rino i ngāwari ki ōku ringa

outcome.label: Hua
options: I whiwhi i ngā Waiata (Zabur) ā, i whakatūria hei rangatira tika
I whakaorangia mai i te puku o te ika, ā, i whakapono te iwi
I whakaorangia taku iwi i te ringa o te kaitukino
I whakawhiwhia ki te mana whakahaere i te hau me te jinn
Kua ora anō, ā, kua nui ake ngā manaakitanga kua homai
outcome.answer: I whiwhi i ngā Waiata (Zabur) ā, i whakatūria hei rangatira tika

arabic: أَنِ ٱعْمَلْ سَـٰبِغَـٰتٍۢ وَقَدِّرْ فِى ٱلسَّرْدِ ۖ وَٱعْمَلُوا۟ صَـٰلِحًا ۖ إِنِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌۭ
verse: [Commanding him], "Make full coats of mail and calculate [precisely] the links, and work [all of you] righteousness. Indeed I, of what you do, am Seeing." (34:11)
